# Features

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-features.py from the provider's registered types. Do not edit. -->

The provider targets MTN Cloud on OpenStack. The cloud (`MTNNG_CLOUD_AZ_1`) is found automatically: you never configure it.

| | Resources | Data sources |
|---|---|---|
| Available today | 117 | 70 |
| Usable with a customer (sub-tenant) login | 81 | 53 |
| Master tenant only | 36 | 12 |
| Not checked yet with a customer login | 0 | 5 |
| Coming next | 7 | 1 |

## Who can use what

MTN Cloud customers log in to a **sub-tenant**. The platform hides some things from them (clouds, hosts, prices, policies, other tenants), so the **Customer login** column says, for each type:

- **Yes, built for customers**: made for customers. It uses the same calls as the console's own screens, checked with a customer login.
- **Yes (read verified)**: a customer login can read what it manages. Creating and changing are confirmed type by type as acceptance tests are added.
- **No: master tenant only**: customer logins are refused (HTTP 403). Only the MTN Cloud master tenant can use it, and its description says so.
- **Not checked yet**: needs an integration to exist first; not yet tested with a customer login.
- **Yes (no API call)**: builds a value locally and never calls MTN Cloud.

Customer-facing names are used throughout: **MTN Network**, **MTN Router**, **MOS** (MTN Object Storage).

## Master tenant only

These need the MTN Cloud master tenant. A customer login gets HTTP 403.

- **Resources:** `mtncloud_appliance_setting`, `mtncloud_backup_creation_policy`, `mtncloud_backup_setting`, `mtncloud_budget_policy`, `mtncloud_cluster_package`, `mtncloud_cluster_resource_name_policy`, `mtncloud_cypher_access_policy`, `mtncloud_delayed_delete_policy`, `mtncloud_delete_approval_policy`, `mtncloud_guidance_setting`, `mtncloud_hostname_policy`, `mtncloud_instance_name_policy`, `mtncloud_license`, `mtncloud_max_containers_policy`, `mtncloud_max_cores_policy`, `mtncloud_max_hosts_policy`, `mtncloud_max_memory_policy`, `mtncloud_max_storage_policy`, `mtncloud_max_vms_policy`, `mtncloud_monitoring_setting`, `mtncloud_motd_policy`, `mtncloud_network_quota_policy`, `mtncloud_power_schedule_policy`, `mtncloud_price`, `mtncloud_price_set`, `mtncloud_provision_approval_policy`, `mtncloud_provisioning_setting`, `mtncloud_resource_pool_group`, `mtncloud_router_quota_policy`, `mtncloud_service_plan`, `mtncloud_tag_policy`, `mtncloud_tenant`, `mtncloud_tenant_role`, `mtncloud_user_creation_policy`, `mtncloud_user_group_creation_policy`, `mtncloud_workflow_policy`
- **Data sources:** `mtncloud_cloud`, `mtncloud_cloud_datastore`, `mtncloud_clouds`, `mtncloud_plan`, `mtncloud_policies`, `mtncloud_policy`, `mtncloud_price`, `mtncloud_price_set`, `mtncloud_resource_pool`, `mtncloud_tenant`, `mtncloud_tenant_role`, `mtncloud_tenants`

Customers use `mtncloud_projects` instead of `mtncloud_resource_pool`, `mtncloud_plans` instead of `mtncloud_plan`, and `mtncloud_datastores` instead of `mtncloud_cloud_datastore`. They don't need `mtncloud_cloud`: the provider finds the cloud.

## Coming next

Designed, **not available yet**, and all meant for customers. Until `mtncloud_instance` ships, virtual machines can't be created with this provider.

### Resources

| Type | Status | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `mtncloud_floating_ip` | Next | A public IP for an instance whose network is on an MTN Router with an external network, attached at create or later. |
| `mtncloud_project` | Planned | Order a project (resource pool) by name and wait until it and its default security group have synced. |
| `mtncloud_catalog_order` | Planned | Order any catalog service (Kubernetes, managed databases, VPN, firewall, NAT, BYOL appliances and more), with its inputs. |
| `mtncloud_object_storage` | Planned | MOS (MTN Object Storage): S3-compatible keys plus optional buckets, in one resource. |
| `mtncloud_app` | Planned | Apps from blueprints: several instances or containers deployed together. |
| `mtncloud_ssl_certificate` | Planned | Certificates. |
| `mtncloud_load_balancer` | On hold | Load balancers (OpenStack Octavia). |
